Teacher.title: Teacher
Teacher.description: Authorized teacher UID allowlist entry granting access to the Teacher Dashboard.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID of the teacher.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when teacher record was created.

Student.title: Student
Student.description: Student profile, approval state, and per-topic progress tracked under students/{uid}.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID matching the document ID.

isAnonymous.description: Whether the account started as an anonymous guest.

approved.description: Teacher-controlled approval flag. Defaults to false on creation.

blocked.description: Teacher-controlled block flag. Defaults to false on creation.

progress.description: Map of topicId -> { passed, score, attempts, passedAt, updatedAt }.

dailyRetries.description: Daily retry tracker { dateKey, counts } in Asia/Manila time.

TopicsSettings.title: TopicsSettings
TopicsSettings.description: Teacher-controlled lock/unlock overrides, schedule windows, and daily retry caps stored at settings/topics.

maxRetriesPerDay.description: Optional maximum quiz retries allowed per topic per Asia/Manila day (0 = unlimited).

topics.description: Map of topicId -> teacher lock, early unlock, and open/close window rules.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest teacher rule update.

updatedBy.description: UID of the teacher who saved the settings.

/students/{studentId}.description: Student accounts, approval flags, and per-topic progress.

/settings/{settingId}.description: Global topic lock/unlock rules and daily retry policy (settings/topics).
